title: AWKUM Announces Entry Test Schedule for MS/MPhil/MSc/PhD Admissions – July 30, 2026
text:
AWKUM Announces Entry Test Schedule for MS/MPhil/MSc/PhD Admissions – July 30, 2026

Admissions Notice

Entry Test Schedule – MS / MPhil / MSc / PhD Admissions

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan · Department of Computer Science

The entry test for admissions in MS/MPhil/MSc/PhD at AWKUM is scheduled to be held on

Thursday, July 30, 2026
, from
10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon (for MPhil)

and for
PhD (12:30 to 3:30 PM)
at the Department of Computer Science,
Garden Campus, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.

You are kindly requested to arrive on time and make the necessary arrangements to attend.

Date July 30, 2026 | | MPhil Timing 10:00 AM – 12:00 Noon | | PhD Timing 12:30 PM – 3:30 PM

Important Notes

Original CNIC is mandatory to be presented at the exam centre.

All students are required to download and print the payment acknowledgement slip from the online admission form and present it at the examination centre.

The test shall be NTS-General for MPhil and GAT-Subject for PhD students.

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan | Garden Campus | Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
